excerpt_i18n.en: Li Bojie really dislikes the label "genius youth." "Still calling me a youth—I'm middle-aged already. Besides, it refers to a talent program," he joked. About 30 days have passed since the DeepSeek interview controversy that went viral online. During this time, Li Bojie open-sourced his book *In-Depth Understanding of AI Agents* on GitHub, which garnered 28,000 stars in just two weeks. DeepSeek, the company he complained about, has also recently captured public attention with its V4-Flash model release and fundraising news. When asked if he regrets his earlier remarks, he smiled apologetically: "I wouldn't say I regret it. I just couldn't help venting—I never expected it to have such a huge impact." We met Li Bojie near Zhongguancun. Over three hours, he talked about his naivety when starting his business, his understanding of AI technology, and what he has been doing since the interview controversy. A person who has known Li Bojie for years commented, "The public's misunderstanding of Li Bojie lies first in his true skill level and second in the recognition of his achievements, but outsiders can hardly see it clearly." He offered an analogy: "It's like a top Sichuan chef suddenly starting to cook Western food. For most people, it's hard to tell whether he's doing well unless he eventually lands an offer from a five-star Western restaurant." As for his technical caliber, perhaps only time and professional scrutiny can tell. But beyond the noise, we try to look at it more objectively and rationally...

items.title: 上线物业缴费专属入口，支付宝以数字化助力物业行业服务力长效落地
items.raw_excerpt: 今日，克而瑞服务力发布大会举办，支付宝智能物业相关代表登台并发表主题演讲。支付宝物业服务凭借成熟的数字化解决方案成功入选《克而瑞2026中国物业服务力红皮书》，意味着其在智慧社区领域的实践成果获得行业认可。 值得关注的是，支付宝生活缴费同步上线物业缴费专属入口，正式将物业服务接入这一亿级民生窗口。依托18年民生服务运营积累，支付宝打造"服务+缴费"一体化入口，业主办理日常民生业务时即可完成物业费查缴，而对物业合作伙伴来说，配合平台消息推送，形成"触达—转化—沉淀"的完整运营链路。截至目前，已有近5000个小区入驻支付宝生活缴费平台。 为支撑服务长效落地，支付宝以产品、AI、运营三大能力重构物业服务流程。AI对话缴费将多步操作简化为语音指令，支持账单查询、经用户授权后的自动代扣签约，降低业主操作门槛。另外，平台配套缴费优惠、签到活动等运营工具，持续激发缴费意愿。支付宝表示，数智化能力正成为物业提升服务效率的重要支撑。通过便捷缴费、账单提醒、自动代扣及配套运营工具，部分合作小区的业主主动缴费意愿有所提升，物业催缴和收费运营效率也得到改善。 未来，支付宝将持续深耕社区服务赛道，以数字化底座赋能物业合作伙伴，推动行业由规模扩张转向品质运营，实现业主满意度与企业经营效益的双向提升。 雷峰网 雷峰网
